categories.label: Content Type
categories.question: What should this content do?
categories.description: The job this piece of content has. Mix your types across the week so your feed teaches, entertains and sells.

items.label: Educate
items.description: Content that teaches your audience something useful. It builds trust and positions you as the expert people come back to.
items.brief: Teach {audience} something useful so they save it and see {brand} as the expert.
howTo: Pick one lesson per video. Don't teach everything at once.
Lead with the benefit: what will they be able to do after watching?
Use on-screen text so it works on mute.
End by asking them to save it for later.
items.example: A dentist explains the 3 foods that stain your teeth the most.
hooks: Here's what nobody tells you about {subject}
Save this if you want to understand {subject}
The one thing you need to know about {subject}

ms.description: Content yang mengajar sesuatu yang berguna kepada penonton. Ia membina kepercayaan dan menjadikan anda pakar yang orang rujuk.
ms.brief: Ajar {audience} sesuatu yang berguna supaya mereka simpan video ini dan lihat {brand} sebagai pakar.
howTo: Satu pelajaran untuk satu video. Jangan ajar semua sekali gus.
Mulakan dengan manfaat: apa yang mereka boleh buat selepas menonton?
Guna teks di skrin supaya video tetap faham walaupun tanpa bunyi.
Akhiri dengan ajak mereka save video untuk rujukan.
ms.example: Doktor gigi terangkan 3 makanan yang paling cepat menyebabkan gigi kuning.
hooks: Ini yang tiada siapa beritahu anda tentang {subject}
Save video ni kalau anda nak faham tentang {subject}
Satu perkara yang anda perlu tahu tentang {subject}

items.label: Traffic Content
items.description: Content made to pull in traffic. Its job is comments, shares and tags, which push your reach to new people and bring them to your page.
items.brief: Get {audience} commenting, sharing and tagging friends so the post reaches new people.
howTo: Make it easy to answer in one word or one emoji.
Ask about something people already have an opinion on.
Reply to comments in the first hour to keep the conversation going.
Pin the best comment.
items.example: A kopitiam asks: teh tarik or kopi O? Comment your order.
hooks: Be honest: what do you think about {subject}?
Tag someone who needs to hear this about {subject}
Let's settle this once and for all: {subject}

ms.description: Content untuk tarik trafik. Tugasnya ialah dapatkan komen, share dan tag, yang membawa reach anda kepada orang baru dan ke page anda.
ms.brief: Buat {audience} komen, share dan tag kawan supaya post ini sampai kepada orang baru.
howTo: Buat soalan yang boleh dijawab dengan satu perkataan atau satu emoji.
Tanya tentang perkara yang orang memang ada pendapat.
Balas komen dalam sejam pertama supaya perbualan terus hidup.
Pin komen yang terbaik.
ms.example: Kopitiam tanya: teh tarik atau kopi O? Komen order anda.
hooks: Jujur: apa pendapat anda tentang {subject}?
Tag kawan yang perlu dengar ini tentang {subject}
Jom selesaikan sekali untuk semua: {subject}

items.label: Business Ads
items.description: Ad-style content that sells. It turns viewers into buyers by showing the offer, the proof and the next step.
items.brief: Turn viewers into buyers of {product}: show the offer, the proof and exactly what to do next.
howTo: Be clear about the offer: what it is, the price or promo, and the deadline.
Show proof: results, reviews, numbers.
Give one clear next step (WhatsApp, link, visit).
Don't post only this type. Balance it with Educate and Traffic Content.
items.example: A tudung brand shows its new Raya collection with a 48-hour early-bird price.
hooks: Don't scroll past this if you care about {subject}
Here's why everyone's talking about {subject}
The deal you've been waiting for: {subject}

ms.description: Content gaya iklan yang menjual. Ia menukar penonton kepada pembeli dengan menunjukkan tawaran, bukti dan langkah seterusnya.
ms.brief: Tukar penonton kepada pembeli {product}: tunjuk tawaran, bukti dan apa yang perlu dibuat seterusnya.
howTo: Jelaskan tawaran: apa produknya, harga atau promosi, dan tarikh tamat.
Tunjuk bukti: hasil, review, angka.
Beri satu langkah seterusnya yang jelas (WhatsApp, link, datang ke kedai).
Jangan post jenis ini sahaja. Seimbangkan dengan Educate dan Traffic Content.
ms.example: Jenama tudung tunjuk koleksi Raya baharu dengan harga early-bird selama 48 jam.
hooks: Jangan scroll dulu kalau anda ambil berat tentang {subject}
Ini sebab semua orang bercakap tentang {subject}
Tawaran yang anda tunggu-tunggu: {subject}

items.label: Trend
items.description: Content that rides what is already popular (a sound, meme, skit format or dance) and puts your brand into it.
items.brief: Ride a current trend and put {brand}'s own twist on it so it feels native to the feed.
howTo: Scroll your For You page for 10 minutes and note the sounds and formats that keep repeating.
Jump on trends early: within days, not weeks.
Keep the format recognisable; change the context to your business.
Save the trending sound to your favourites before you shoot.
items.example: A property agent uses a trending sound to act out 'me explaining the SPA to first-time buyers'.
hooks: Everyone's doing this trend, so here's {subject}
Trend check: {subject} edition
Tell me you know {subject} without telling me

ms.description: Content yang menunggang trend semasa (bunyi, meme, format lakonan atau tarian) dan memasukkan jenama anda ke dalamnya.
ms.brief: Tunggang trend semasa dan beri sentuhan {brand} sendiri supaya ia terasa sebati dengan feed.
howTo: Scroll For You page selama 10 minit dan catat bunyi dan format yang asyik berulang.
Masuk trend awal: dalam beberapa hari, bukan beberapa minggu.
Kekalkan format yang orang kenal; tukar konteks kepada bisnes anda.
Simpan bunyi trending dalam favourites sebelum mula rakam.
ms.example: Ejen hartanah guna bunyi trending untuk lakonkan "saya terangkan SPA kepada pembeli rumah pertama".
hooks: Semua orang buat trend ni, jadi ini versi {subject}
Trend check: edisi {subject}
Cakap anda tahu tentang {subject} tanpa cakap

items.label: Inspire
items.description: Content that moves people: transformations, journeys and motivation. It builds a loyal audience that roots for you.
items.brief: Move {audience} emotionally so they remember {brand} and root for you.
howTo: Show real emotion. The struggle is what makes the win matter.
Use a slower pace and music that matches the mood.
Keep it honest; audiences can tell when a story is fake.
End with a line people want to share.
items.example: A home baker shares the journey from 5 orders a month to a full-time business.
hooks: This changed how I see {subject}
If {subject} feels hard right now, watch this
Nobody saw this coming: our story with {subject}

ms.description: Content yang menyentuh perasaan: transformasi, perjalanan dan motivasi. Ia membina pengikut setia yang menyokong anda.
ms.brief: Sentuh perasaan {audience} supaya mereka ingat {brand} dan menyokong anda.
howTo: Tunjuk emosi sebenar. Perjuangan itulah yang buat kejayaan bermakna.
Guna rentak lebih perlahan dan muzik yang sesuai dengan mood.
Jujur; penonton boleh rasa kalau cerita itu dibuat-buat.
Akhiri dengan ayat yang orang mahu kongsi.
ms.example: Home baker kongsi perjalanan daripada 5 order sebulan kepada bisnes sepenuh masa.
hooks: Ini yang ubah cara saya lihat {subject}
Kalau {subject} rasa susah sekarang, tonton ini
Tiada siapa sangka: kisah kami dengan {subject}

items.label: Behind the Scenes
items.description: Content that shows what normally happens off camera: the process, the people and the daily grind. It makes your brand human and trustworthy.
items.brief: Show {audience} what happens behind the scenes at {brand} so they trust the people and process behind {product}.
howTo: Film the real, unpolished process. That's the appeal.
Introduce people by name.
Show the effort and care that customers never see.
Film vertical, handheld and close.
items.example: A cake shop shows the 4am prep before a big wedding order.
hooks: What really happens behind {subject}
You've never seen this side of {subject}
Come behind the scenes of {subject}

ms.description: Content yang tunjuk apa yang biasanya berlaku di belakang kamera: proses, orang dan rutin harian. Ia buat jenama anda lebih manusiawi dan dipercayai.
ms.brief: Tunjuk kepada {audience} apa yang berlaku di sebalik tabir {brand} supaya mereka percaya orang dan proses di sebalik {product}.
howTo: Rakam proses sebenar tanpa disolek. Itulah tarikannya.
Perkenalkan orang dengan nama mereka.
Tunjuk usaha dan teliti yang pelanggan tak pernah nampak.
Rakam secara menegak, pegang tangan dan dekat.
ms.example: Kedai kek tunjuk persiapan jam 4 pagi sebelum tempahan majlis kahwin yang besar.
hooks: Apa sebenarnya berlaku di sebalik {subject}
Anda tak pernah tengok sisi ini tentang {subject}
Jom ke belakang tabir {subject}

ms.question: Apa tujuan content ini?
ms.description: Tugas content ini. Campurkan jenis content sepanjang minggu supaya feed anda mendidik, menghiburkan dan menjual.

categories.label: Present Style
categories.question: How will you present it?
categories.description: The format of the video. Any present style works with any content type.

items.label: Storytelling
items.description: Tell a real story (yours, a customer's or the brand's) instead of listing facts or claims. Stories teach and sell better than claims.
items.brief: Tell it as a real story: the situation, the problem, the turning point and what changed.
structure: Hook: drop the viewer into the most dramatic moment of the story.
Context: who, where, what was happening.
Problem: what went wrong or what was at stake.
Turning point: what you learned, or how {product} changed things.
CTA: ask if it has ever happened to them, or share the offer.
hooks: The day I learned the truth about {subject}
Nobody warned me about {subject}
A customer taught me a lesson about {subject}
The story behind {subject}
What happened when a customer asked us about {subject}
howTo: Start in the middle of the action, not with 'so one day...'.
Keep it to one story and one point.
Make the customer the hero, not your product.
Use real names and real results (with permission).
items.example: A mechanic tells the story of a customer who ignored a small engine noise, and the RM3,000 bill that followed.

ms.description: Ceritakan kisah sebenar (anda, pelanggan atau jenama) dan bukan sekadar senarai fakta atau dakwaan. Cerita lebih berkesan untuk mengajar dan menjual.
ms.brief: Sampaikan sebagai cerita sebenar: situasi, masalah, titik perubahan dan apa yang berubah.
structure: Hook: terus masuk ke saat paling dramatik dalam cerita.
Konteks: siapa, di mana, apa yang sedang berlaku.
Masalah: apa yang tak kena atau apa yang dipertaruhkan.
Titik perubahan: apa yang anda belajar, atau bagaimana {product} mengubah keadaan.
CTA: tanya sama ada mereka pernah alaminya, atau kongsi tawaran.
hooks: Hari saya tahu kebenaran tentang {subject}
Tiada siapa beritahu saya tentang {subject}
Seorang pelanggan ajar saya sesuatu tentang {subject}
Kisah di sebalik {subject}
Apa jadi bila seorang pelanggan tanya kami tentang {subject}
howTo: Mula di tengah-tengah aksi, bukan dengan "jadi satu hari tu...".
Satu cerita, satu poin.
Jadikan pelanggan wira cerita, bukan produk anda.
Guna nama dan hasil sebenar (dengan izin).
ms.example: Mekanik cerita tentang pelanggan yang abaikan bunyi kecil pada enjin, dan bil RM3,000 yang menyusul.

items.label: Facts
items.description: Share surprising, true facts your audience didn't know. Short, punchy and very saveable.
items.brief: Share surprising facts, one per scene, that make people say 'I didn't know that'.
structure: Hook: open with the most surprising fact.
Explain it simply in one or two lines.
Say why it matters to {audience}.
Optional: stack two or three more facts.
CTA: 'Follow for more facts like this.'
hooks: Most people don't know this about {subject}
A surprising fact about {subject}
The truth about {subject} in 30 seconds
howTo: Check your facts. One wrong fact destroys trust.
Put the fact on screen as text.
Use a number whenever you can.
items.example: A skincare brand explains why you still need sunscreen on a cloudy day.

ms.description: Kongsi fakta benar yang mengejutkan dan penonton tak tahu. Pendek, padat dan orang suka save.
ms.brief: Kongsi fakta mengejutkan, satu fakta satu babak, sampai orang kata "tak tahu pun".
structure: Hook: buka dengan fakta paling mengejutkan.
Terangkan dengan mudah dalam satu atau dua ayat.
Kenapa ia penting kepada {audience}.
Pilihan: tambah dua atau tiga fakta lagi.
CTA: "Follow untuk lebih banyak fakta macam ni."
hooks: Ramai orang tak tahu ini tentang {subject}
Satu fakta mengejutkan tentang {subject}
Kebenaran tentang {subject} dalam 30 saat
howTo: Semak fakta anda. Satu fakta salah boleh rosakkan kepercayaan.
Letak fakta sebagai teks di skrin.
Guna angka bila boleh.
ms.example: Jenama skincare terangkan kenapa anda masih perlu sunscreen pada hari mendung.

items.label: Top 3/5
items.description: A countdown list of 3 or 5 points. Easy to follow and easy to watch till the end.
items.brief: Count down 3 or 5 quick points, saving the best one for last.
structure: Hook: say the list title, 'Top 3 ...'.
Point #3 (good).
Point #2 (better).
Point #1 (best, the reason to watch till the end).
CTA: ask which one they would add.
hooks: Top 3 things to know about {subject}
Top 5 mistakes people make when it comes to {subject}
3 things I wish I knew earlier about {subject}
howTo: Put the number in the hook. It tells viewers how long to stay.
One scene per point.
Save the strongest point for #1.
items.example: A travel agent counts down the top 5 hidden spots in Langkawi.

ms.description: Senarai kira detik 3 atau 5 perkara. Senang diikuti dan orang tonton sampai habis.
ms.brief: Kira detik 3 atau 5 perkara secara pantas, simpan yang terbaik untuk akhir.
structure: Hook: sebut tajuk senarai, "Top 3 ...".
Perkara #3 (bagus).
Perkara #2 (lebih bagus).
Perkara #1 (terbaik, sebab orang tonton sampai habis).
CTA: tanya apa yang mereka nak tambah.
hooks: 3 perkara yang anda perlu tahu tentang {subject}
5 kesilapan yang orang selalu buat bila melibatkan {subject}
3 perkara yang saya harap saya tahu lebih awal tentang {subject}
howTo: Letak nombor dalam hook. Ia beritahu penonton berapa lama perlu tonton.
Satu babak untuk satu perkara.
Simpan perkara paling kuat untuk #1.
ms.example: Agen pelancongan kira detik 5 lokasi tersembunyi di Langkawi.

items.label: How-To Tutorial
items.description: A step-by-step guide that shows exactly how to do something, so viewers can copy you right away.
items.brief: Walk through it step by step so viewers can copy you right away.
structure: Hook: show the end result first.
Step 1, step 2, step 3, one scene each.
A common mistake to avoid.
CTA: 'Save this so you can try it later.'
hooks: Do this, not that, when it comes to {subject}
The simple 3-step guide to {subject}
Here's exactly how we handle {subject}
howTo: Show, don't just tell. Film your hands doing each step.
Number each step on screen.
Keep each step under 10 seconds.
items.example: A barista shows how to make a proper kopi at home in 3 steps.

ms.description: Panduan langkah demi langkah yang tunjuk cara buat sesuatu, supaya penonton boleh terus ikut.
ms.brief: Tunjuk langkah demi langkah supaya penonton boleh terus ikut.
structure: Hook: tunjuk hasil akhir dahulu.
Langkah 1, langkah 2, langkah 3, satu babak setiap satu.
Satu kesilapan biasa yang perlu dielak.
CTA: "Save video ni supaya boleh cuba nanti."
hooks: Buat ini, jangan buat itu, bila melibatkan {subject}
Panduan 3 langkah mudah untuk {subject}
Ini cara kami uruskan {subject}
howTo: Tunjuk, jangan cakap saja. Rakam tangan anda buat setiap langkah.
Nomborkan setiap langkah di skrin.
Setiap langkah bawah 10 saat.
ms.example: Barista tunjuk cara bancuh kopi sedap di rumah dalam 3 langkah.

items.label: Myth vs Fact
items.description: Bust a common belief in your industry: say the myth, then reveal the truth.
items.brief: Bust a common myth and replace it with the truth.
structure: Hook: state the myth as if it's true.
Big 'MYTH' stamp or buzzer.
Reveal the fact, with proof.
Repeat for one or two more myths.
CTA: 'What other myths have you heard?'
hooks: Stop believing these myths about {subject}
Myth or fact? Let's test what you know about {subject}
You've been told the wrong thing about {subject}
howTo: Pick myths your customers actually believe. Check your comments and DMs.
Use a clear visual for MYTH and FACT (colours, stamps, sounds).
Back the fact with proof or experience.
items.example: A personal trainer busts the myth that you can't eat rice if you want to lose weight.

ms.description: Patahkan kepercayaan biasa dalam industri anda: sebut mitosnya, kemudian dedahkan kebenarannya.
ms.brief: Patahkan satu mitos biasa dan gantikan dengan kebenaran.
structure: Hook: sebut mitos seolah-olah ia benar.
Cop "MITOS" besar atau bunyi buzzer.
Dedahkan fakta, dengan bukti.
Ulang untuk satu atau dua mitos lagi.
CTA: "Mitos apa lagi yang anda pernah dengar?"
hooks: Berhenti percaya mitos ini tentang {subject}
Mitos atau fakta? Jom uji apa yang anda tahu tentang {subject}
Selama ini anda diberitahu benda yang salah tentang {subject}
howTo: Pilih mitos yang pelanggan anda betul-betul percaya. Semak komen dan DM.
Guna visual yang jelas untuk MITOS dan FAKTA (warna, cop, bunyi).
Sokong fakta dengan bukti atau pengalaman.
ms.example: Jurulatih peribadi patahkan mitos bahawa anda tak boleh makan nasi kalau nak kurus.

items.label: Quiz + Reward
items.description: Ask a question and give a prize for the correct (or a random) answer. Rewards drive a huge number of comments.
items.brief: Ask a question and reward the winners. The prize is what drives the comments.
structure: Hook: 'Answer this and win ...'.
Show the question (and options).
Explain how to enter: comment, follow, tag a friend.
State the deadline and when winners are announced.
Follow up with a winner-announcement video.
hooks: Answer this question about {subject} and win a prize!
Giveaway: get this question about {subject} right and win
howTo: Make the prize relevant to your business to attract buyers, not freebie hunters.
Keep the rules simple. Comment plus follow is enough.
Always announce winners publicly. It builds trust for the next one.
Check the platform's promotion rules before running a giveaway.
items.example: A burger shop asks people to guess how many patties it sold last weekend. The closest answer wins a free meal.

ms.description: Tanya soalan dan beri hadiah kepada jawapan betul (atau pemenang rawak). Hadiah menarik banyak komen.
ms.brief: Tanya soalan dan beri hadiah kepada pemenang. Hadiah itulah yang menarik komen.
structure: Hook: "Jawab soalan ni dan menang ...".
Tunjuk soalan (dan pilihan jawapan).
Terangkan cara menyertai: komen, follow, tag kawan.
Nyatakan tarikh tutup dan bila pemenang diumumkan.
Susuli dengan video pengumuman pemenang.
hooks: Jawab soalan ini tentang {subject} dan menang hadiah!
Giveaway: jawab betul soalan tentang {subject} dan menang
howTo: Pilih hadiah yang berkaitan dengan bisnes anda supaya yang datang ialah pembeli, bukan pemburu barang percuma.
Peraturan mudah. Komen dan follow sudah cukup.
Sentiasa umumkan pemenang secara terbuka. Ia bina kepercayaan untuk giveaway seterusnya.
Semak peraturan promosi platform sebelum buat giveaway.
ms.example: Kedai burger minta orang teka berapa patty yang terjual hujung minggu lepas. Jawapan paling dekat menang makan percuma.

items.label: A or B
items.description: Give two choices and ask people to pick one. The lowest-effort way to get comments.
items.brief: Give two clear options and ask viewers to pick one in the comments.
structure: Hook: 'A or B?' with both options on screen.
Show option A.
Show option B.
CTA: 'Comment A or B.'
hooks: A or B: which one wins when it comes to {subject}?
You can only pick one. Settle the debate about {subject}
howTo: Make both options equally tempting. A one-sided choice gets no debate.
Label them clearly: A on the left, B on the right.
Reply to comments and pick a side yourself.
items.example: A nasi lemak stall: sambal manis or sambal pedas? Comment A or B.

ms.description: Beri dua pilihan dan minta orang pilih satu. Cara paling mudah untuk dapat komen.
ms.brief: Beri dua pilihan yang jelas dan minta penonton pilih satu di ruangan komen.
structure: Hook: "A atau B?" dengan kedua-dua pilihan di skrin.
Tunjuk pilihan A.
Tunjuk pilihan B.
CTA: "Komen A atau B."
hooks: A atau B: mana satu menang bila melibatkan {subject}?
Pilih satu saja. Jom selesaikan perdebatan tentang {subject}
howTo: Buat kedua-dua pilihan sama menarik. Pilihan berat sebelah tak akan jadi perdebatan.
Labelkan dengan jelas: A di kiri, B di kanan.
Balas komen dan pilih satu pihak sendiri.
ms.example: Gerai nasi lemak: sambal manis atau sambal pedas? Komen A atau B.

items.label: A or B + Pendapat
items.description: Like A or B, but viewers also have to explain why. Longer comments mean more engagement and real insight into your audience.
items.brief: Give two options and ask viewers to pick one and explain why (pendapat).
structure: Hook: the choice, framed as a debate.
Show both options.
Give your own pick and one reason.
CTA: 'Which one, and why? Tell me in the comments.'
hooks: Which would you pick when it comes to {subject}? Defend your answer
Unpopular opinion about {subject}. Agree or not?
howTo: Take a side yourself. It invites people to disagree.
Read the best comments in a follow-up video.
Use what people say as research for your next content.
items.example: A car dealer: new car or recond? Tell us which and why.

ms.description: Macam A atau B, tetapi penonton juga perlu beri sebab. Komen lebih panjang bermakna lebih engagement dan anda kenal audiens dengan lebih dalam.
ms.brief: Beri dua pilihan dan minta penonton pilih satu serta beri pendapat kenapa.
structure: Hook: pilihan itu, dibingkaikan sebagai perdebatan.
Tunjuk kedua-dua pilihan.
Beri pilihan anda sendiri dan satu sebab.
CTA: "Mana satu, dan kenapa? Komen di bawah."
hooks: Mana satu pilihan anda bila melibatkan {subject}? Pertahankan jawapan anda
Pendapat tak popular tentang {subject}. Setuju atau tidak?
howTo: Pilih satu pihak sendiri. Ia jemput orang untuk tak setuju.
Baca komen terbaik dalam video susulan.
Guna apa yang orang cakap sebagai kajian untuk content seterusnya.
ms.example: Pengedar kereta: kereta baru atau recond? Beritahu pilihan dan sebabnya.

items.label: Quiz
items.description: A quick question or test that viewers answer in their head or in the comments. People love proving they know the answer.
items.brief: Ask a quick quiz question and make viewers want to prove they know the answer.
structure: Hook: the question, with a challenge ('only 1 in 10 get this right').
Show the options or a countdown timer.
Pause, or tell them to comment before the reveal.
Reveal the answer, with a short explanation.
CTA: 'Did you get it right?'
hooks: Only 1 in 10 people get this right about {subject}
Quick quiz: how much do you really know about {subject}?
howTo: Make it hard enough to be interesting, easy enough to guess.
Put a countdown on screen to build tension.
Reveal the answer at the end, or in the comments.
items.example: A clinic asks: which drink has more sugar, teh tarik or a can of soda?

ms.description: Soalan atau ujian pendek yang penonton jawab dalam kepala atau di ruangan komen. Orang suka buktikan mereka tahu jawapannya.
ms.brief: Tanya satu soalan kuiz pantas dan buat penonton nak buktikan mereka tahu jawapannya.
structure: Hook: soalan, dengan cabaran ("hanya 1 dalam 10 orang jawab betul").
Tunjuk pilihan jawapan atau pemasa kira detik.
Berhenti seketika, atau suruh mereka komen sebelum jawapan didedahkan.
Dedahkan jawapan, dengan penerangan ringkas.
CTA: "Anda jawab betul tak?"
hooks: Hanya 1 dalam 10 orang jawab betul tentang {subject}
Kuiz pantas: sejauh mana anda tahu tentang {subject}?
howTo: Cukup susah untuk menarik, cukup senang untuk diteka.
Letak pemasa kira detik di skrin untuk bina debaran.
Dedahkan jawapan di akhir video, atau dalam komen.
ms.example: Klinik tanya: mana lebih banyak gula, teh tarik atau setin air bergas?

items.label: Hard Sell
items.description: A direct pitch: here's the product, here's the offer, buy now. Works best on warm audiences and with a deadline.
items.brief: Pitch {product} directly: the offer, the price, the deadline and how to buy.
structure: Hook: call out the buyer ('If you need ..., stop scrolling').
Show the product and its top benefit.
The offer: price, bonus, deadline.
Proof: a review or a result.
CTA: exactly how to buy, right now.
hooks: Stop scrolling if you've been thinking about {subject}
If you care about {subject}, this offer is for you
howTo: Create urgency with a real deadline or limited stock.
Show the price. Hiding it loses buyers.
Use it in about 1 in 5 posts so your feed doesn't feel like an ad.
items.example: A furniture shop shows its best-selling sofa with RM300 off this weekend only.

ms.description: Pitching terus: ini produknya, ini tawarannya, beli sekarang. Paling berkesan untuk audiens yang sudah kenal anda dan bila ada tarikh tamat.
ms.brief: Pitch {product} secara terus: tawaran, harga, tarikh tamat dan cara membeli.
structure: Hook: panggil pembeli ("Kalau anda perlukan ..., berhenti scroll").
Tunjuk produk dan manfaat utamanya.
Tawaran: harga, bonus, tarikh tamat.
Bukti: review atau hasil.
CTA: cara membeli, sekarang juga.
hooks: Berhenti scroll kalau anda dah lama fikir tentang {subject}
Kalau anda ambil berat tentang {subject}, tawaran ini untuk anda
howTo: Cipta rasa terdesak dengan tarikh tamat sebenar atau stok terhad.
Tunjuk harga. Sorok harga akan buat pembeli lari.
Guna untuk lebih kurang 1 daripada 5 post supaya feed anda tak rasa macam iklan.
ms.example: Kedai perabot tunjuk sofa paling laris dengan potongan RM300 hujung minggu ini sahaja.

items.label: Feedback
items.description: Let your customers do the selling: reviews, testimonials, screenshots of messages and before/after results.
items.brief: Let customers sell for you: real reviews, testimonials and results for {product}.
structure: Hook: the most powerful line from the review.
Who the customer is and what their problem was.
What they say about {product}.
Proof on screen (screenshot, before/after).
CTA: invite viewers to try it too.
hooks: What our customers really say about {subject}
Real customers, honest opinions on {subject}
howTo: Always ask the customer for permission first.
Video testimonials beat screenshots; screenshots beat nothing.
Choose reviews that answer a common doubt.
items.example: A renovation company shows WhatsApp messages from a happy client next to the finished kitchen.

ms.description: Biar pelanggan yang menjual untuk anda: review, testimoni, screenshot mesej dan hasil sebelum/selepas.
ms.brief: Biar pelanggan menjual untuk anda: review sebenar, testimoni dan hasil {product}.
structure: Hook: ayat paling kuat daripada review.
Siapa pelanggan itu dan apa masalahnya.
Apa kata mereka tentang {product}.
Bukti di skrin (screenshot, sebelum/selepas).
CTA: ajak penonton cuba juga.
hooks: Apa pelanggan kami betul-betul cakap tentang {subject}
Pelanggan sebenar, pendapat jujur tentang {subject}
howTo: Sentiasa minta izin pelanggan dahulu.
Testimoni video lebih baik daripada screenshot; screenshot lebih baik daripada tiada.
Pilih review yang menjawab keraguan biasa.
ms.example: Syarikat renovasi tunjuk mesej WhatsApp daripada klien yang gembira di sebelah dapur yang siap.

items.label: Problem → Solution
items.description: Show a problem your customers know too well, then show how your product fixes it. A soft sell that doesn't feel like an ad.
items.brief: Show a problem {audience} know too well, then show {product} fixing it.
structure: Hook: show the problem in action.
Agitate: why it's so annoying or costly.
Reveal {product} as the fix.
Show it working.
CTA: where to get it.
hooks: The biggest problem with {subject}, and how we fix it
Still struggling when it comes to {subject}? Watch this
howTo: Exaggerate the problem a little for effect, but keep the solution real.
Show, don't claim. Film it working.
Pair it with a before/after split screen.
items.example: A cleaning service shows a greasy kitchen hood, then the sparkling result.

ms.description: Tunjuk masalah yang pelanggan anda sangat kenal, kemudian tunjuk bagaimana produk anda selesaikannya. Soft sell yang tak rasa macam iklan.
ms.brief: Tunjuk masalah yang {audience} sangat kenal, kemudian tunjuk {product} menyelesaikannya.
structure: Hook: tunjuk masalah itu sedang berlaku.
Tekankan: kenapa ia sangat menjengkelkan atau merugikan.
Dedahkan {product} sebagai penyelesaian.
Tunjuk ia berfungsi.
CTA: di mana nak dapatkan.
hooks: Masalah terbesar tentang {subject}, dan cara kami selesaikannya
Masih pening bila melibatkan {subject}? Tonton ini
howTo: Besarkan sedikit masalahnya untuk kesan, tetapi kekalkan penyelesaian yang sebenar.
Tunjuk, jangan dakwa. Rakam ia berfungsi.
Gandingkan dengan split screen sebelum/selepas.
ms.example: Servis cuci tunjuk hood dapur yang berminyak, kemudian hasil yang berkilat.

items.label: Lakonan
items.description: A short acted skit, usually following a trending format or sound: POV scenes, 'types of customers', dramatic re-enactments.
items.brief: Act it out as a short skit (lakonan) using a trending format or sound.
structure: Hook: set up the scene with a 'POV:' or 'When...' caption.
Act out the situation (play several characters if needed).
The twist or punchline.
Tie it back to {brand} in a subtle way.
CTA: 'Tag someone who does this.'
hooks: POV: you finally understand {subject}
When your friend asks you about {subject}
howTo: Use a trending sound or skit format so the algorithm pushes it.
Keep it under 30 seconds with a clear punchline.
Costume or prop changes make multiple characters clear.
items.example: A bakery acts out 'types of customers when the kek lapis runs out'.

ms.description: Lakonan pendek, biasanya ikut format atau bunyi yang sedang trending: babak POV, "jenis-jenis pelanggan", lakonan semula yang dramatik.
ms.brief: Lakonkan dalam bentuk sketsa pendek menggunakan format atau bunyi yang trending.
structure: Hook: sediakan babak dengan kapsyen "POV:" atau "Bila...".
Lakonkan situasi (bawa beberapa watak jika perlu).
Twist atau punchline.
Kaitkan dengan {brand} secara halus.
CTA: "Tag kawan yang buat macam ni."
hooks: POV: akhirnya anda faham tentang {subject}
Bila kawan tanya anda tentang {subject}
howTo: Guna bunyi atau format sketsa yang trending supaya algoritma tolak video anda.
Bawah 30 saat dengan punchline yang jelas.
Tukar kostum atau prop supaya beberapa watak jelas dibezakan.
ms.example: Kedai kek lakonkan "jenis-jenis pelanggan bila kek lapis habis".

items.label: Dance
items.description: Join a trending dance or choreography, with your team, your product or your shop as the twist.
items.brief: Do the trending dance, with {brand}'s team, product or shop as the twist.
structure: Hook: the text overlay that gives the dance its context.
The dance (follow the trend closely).
Your twist: product, uniform, location or team.
CTA: 'Follow for more' or tag a friend.
hooks: Me after figuring out {subject}
Our team when someone asks about {subject}
howTo: Learn the trend from the original video first.
The text overlay is what makes it about your business.
It doesn't have to be perfect. Fun beats polished.
items.example: A clinic's nurses do a trending dance with the caption 'when the last patient of the day leaves'.

ms.description: Sertai tarian atau koreografi yang trending, dengan team, produk atau kedai anda sebagai twist.
ms.brief: Buat tarian trending, dengan team, produk atau kedai {brand} sebagai twist.
structure: Hook: teks di skrin yang beri konteks kepada tarian.
Tarian (ikut trend dengan rapat).
Twist anda: produk, uniform, lokasi atau team.
CTA: "Follow untuk lagi" atau tag kawan.
hooks: Saya selepas faham tentang {subject}
Team kami bila ada orang tanya tentang {subject}
howTo: Belajar trend daripada video asal dahulu.
Teks di skrin itulah yang menjadikan ia tentang bisnes anda.
Tak perlu sempurna. Seronok lebih penting daripada cantik.
ms.example: Jururawat klinik buat tarian trending dengan kapsyen "bila pesakit terakhir hari ini dah balik".

items.label: Trending Sound / Meme
items.description: Use a viral sound or meme format and apply it to your business. Low effort, high reach.
items.brief: Use a viral sound or meme format and apply it to {brand}'s world.
structure: Hook: the text overlay that sets up the meme.
Lip-sync or act to the sound.
The punchline, tied to your business.
CTA: tag someone who relates.
hooks: Me explaining {subject} to my friends
Nobody: ... Me when someone mentions {subject}:
howTo: Use the sound while it's rising, not when it's already everywhere.
Match the meaning of the sound to your situation.
Keep it short. Most meme videos are under 15 seconds.
items.example: A property agent lip-syncs to a trending sound: 'when the buyer says the loan is approved'.

ms.description: Guna bunyi viral atau format meme dan kaitkan dengan bisnes anda. Usaha rendah, reach tinggi.
ms.brief: Guna bunyi viral atau format meme dan kaitkan dengan dunia {brand}.
structure: Hook: teks di skrin yang menyediakan meme.
Lip-sync atau berlakon mengikut bunyi.
Punchline, dikaitkan dengan bisnes anda.
CTA: tag orang yang relate.
hooks: Saya terangkan tentang {subject} kepada kawan-kawan
Tiada siapa: ... Saya bila ada orang sebut tentang {subject}:
howTo: Guna bunyi itu ketika ia sedang naik, bukan bila semua orang dah guna.
Padankan maksud bunyi dengan situasi anda.
Pendekkan. Kebanyakan video meme bawah 15 saat.
ms.example: Ejen hartanah lip-sync bunyi trending: "bila pembeli cakap loan dah lulus".

items.label: Before & After
items.description: Show a transformation: a person, a space, a product or a business, from before to after.
items.brief: Show the transformation, before and after, and let the result speak.
structure: Hook: flash the 'after' for a split second.
The 'before', honest and unflattering.
The process (sped up).
The big reveal.
CTA: 'Want the same result? ...'
hooks: From zero to this: our journey with {subject}
Before and after: see what changed with {subject}
howTo: Shoot the before and after from the exact same angle.
Use a transition (snap, whip pan, cover the lens) for the reveal.
Time-lapse the middle.
items.example: A landscaper shows an overgrown garden turned into a family-friendly backyard.

ms.description: Tunjuk transformasi: orang, ruang, produk atau bisnes, dari sebelum ke selepas.
ms.brief: Tunjuk transformasi, sebelum dan selepas, dan biar hasilnya bercakap.
structure: Hook: imbas hasil "selepas" sekejap.
Keadaan "sebelum", jujur dan tanpa solekan.
Proses (dipercepatkan).
Pendedahan besar.
CTA: "Nak hasil yang sama? ..."
hooks: Dari kosong ke tahap ini: perjalanan kami dengan {subject}
Sebelum dan selepas: tengok apa yang berubah dengan {subject}
howTo: Rakam sebelum dan selepas dari sudut yang sama.
Guna transisi (petik jari, whip pan, tutup lensa) untuk pendedahan.
Time-lapse bahagian tengah.
ms.example: Landskap tunjuk laman yang semak bertukar menjadi halaman mesra keluarga.

items.label: Struggle to Success
items.description: Share an honest journey from hard times to where you are now. Vulnerability builds loyal fans.
items.brief: Share the honest journey from struggle to where {brand} is today.
structure: Hook: the lowest point.
What was going wrong.
The turning point.
Where you are now (with proof).
The lesson for {audience}.
hooks: I almost gave up on {subject}
From struggling with {subject} to this
howTo: Use old photos and videos. They make it real.
Don't brag at the end; share the lesson.
Talk to camera for the emotional parts.
items.example: A caterer shares starting from a home kitchen during the pandemic and now running a central kitchen.

ms.description: Kongsi perjalanan jujur dari masa susah ke tahap sekarang. Kejujuran membina peminat setia.
ms.brief: Kongsi perjalanan jujur dari susah ke tahap {brand} hari ini.
structure: Hook: titik paling rendah.
Apa yang tak kena ketika itu.
Titik perubahan.
Di mana anda sekarang (dengan bukti).
Pengajaran untuk {audience}.
hooks: Saya hampir putus asa dengan {subject}
Dari bergelut dengan {subject} sampai ke tahap ini
howTo: Guna gambar dan video lama. Ia buat cerita lebih nyata.
Jangan berlagak di akhir; kongsi pengajarannya.
Bercakap terus ke kamera untuk bahagian yang emosional.
ms.example: Katerer kongsi bermula dari dapur rumah semasa pandemik dan kini menguruskan dapur pusat.

items.label: Motivational Talk
items.description: A short, heartfelt message that encourages your audience. Shareable and great for building a personal brand.
items.brief: Give {audience} a short, heartfelt message of encouragement.
structure: Hook: speak to a feeling ('If you feel stuck ...').
The message or lesson in 2–3 lines.
A personal example.
The line people will screenshot.
CTA: 'Send this to someone who needs it.'
hooks: If you're worried about {subject}, watch this
A reminder for anyone thinking about {subject}
howTo: Speak slowly and look into the lens.
Soft background music, captions on.
Keep it under 45 seconds.
items.example: A business coach reminds new entrepreneurs that the first year is supposed to be hard.

ms.description: Mesej pendek dari hati yang memberi semangat kepada audiens. Senang dikongsi dan bagus untuk membina personal brand.
ms.brief: Beri {audience} mesej pendek dari hati untuk memberi semangat.
structure: Hook: sentuh satu perasaan ("Kalau anda rasa buntu ...").
Mesej atau pengajaran dalam 2–3 ayat.
Contoh peribadi.
Ayat yang orang akan screenshot.
CTA: "Hantar video ni kepada orang yang perlukannya."
hooks: Kalau anda risau tentang {subject}, tonton ini
Peringatan untuk sesiapa yang sedang fikir tentang {subject}
howTo: Bercakap perlahan dan pandang lensa.
Muzik latar lembut, kapsyen dihidupkan.
Bawah 45 saat.
ms.example: Business coach ingatkan usahawan baru bahawa tahun pertama memang sepatutnya susah.

items.label: Day in the Life
items.description: Follow a day at your business from open to close. People love seeing how things really run.
items.brief: Follow a real day at {brand} from open to close.
structure: Hook: the time and the first task ('5:30am, first batch of the day').
Quick clips through the day, with time stamps.
One challenge or surprise moment.
End of day, with the result.
CTA: 'Want to see more days like this?'
hooks: A day in the life at {brand}: {subject}
Come spend a day with us and see {subject} up close
howTo: Put the time on screen for each clip.
Film many short clips, 2–3 seconds each.
Voiceover or captions tell the story.
items.example: A florist shows a full day before Valentine's, from 6am delivery to the last bouquet.

ms.description: Ikut sehari di bisnes anda dari buka sampai tutup. Orang suka tengok bagaimana sesuatu itu benar-benar berjalan.
ms.brief: Ikut satu hari sebenar di {brand} dari buka sampai tutup.
structure: Hook: masa dan tugas pertama ("5:30 pagi, batch pertama hari ini").
Klip pantas sepanjang hari, dengan cap masa.
Satu cabaran atau saat mengejutkan.
Penghujung hari, dengan hasilnya.
CTA: "Nak tengok lagi hari macam ni?"
hooks: Sehari di {brand}: {subject}
Jom luangkan sehari bersama kami dan tengok {subject} dari dekat
howTo: Letak masa di skrin untuk setiap klip.
Rakam banyak klip pendek, 2–3 saat setiap satu.
Voiceover atau kapsyen yang bercerita.
ms.example: Kedai bunga tunjuk sehari penuh sebelum Hari Valentine, dari penghantaran 6 pagi hingga jambak terakhir.

items.label: How It's Made
items.description: Show the process of making or delivering your product or service. Satisfying to watch and builds perceived value.
items.brief: Show how {product} is made or delivered, step by step.
structure: Hook: the most satisfying moment of the process.
Raw materials or starting point.
Each step, sped up.
The finished product.
CTA: how to order.
hooks: How it's made: {subject}
What really goes on behind {subject}
howTo: Close-ups and satisfying sounds work best.
Speed up the boring parts.
Show the care and quality checks.
items.example: A batik maker shows the canting, dyeing and drying process.

ms.description: Tunjuk proses membuat atau menyampaikan produk atau servis anda. Puas ditonton dan menaikkan nilai di mata pelanggan.
ms.brief: Tunjuk bagaimana {product} dibuat atau disampaikan, langkah demi langkah.
structure: Hook: saat paling memuaskan dalam proses.
Bahan mentah atau titik permulaan.
Setiap langkah, dipercepatkan.
Produk siap.
CTA: cara membuat tempahan.
hooks: Macam mana ia dibuat: {subject}
Apa sebenarnya berlaku di sebalik {subject}
howTo: Close-up dan bunyi yang memuaskan paling berkesan.
Percepatkan bahagian yang membosankan.
Tunjuk teliti dan pemeriksaan kualiti.
ms.example: Pembuat batik tunjuk proses canting, celup dan jemur.

items.label: Meet the Team
items.description: Introduce the people behind your business: their roles, personalities and fun facts.
items.brief: Introduce the people behind {brand}, their roles and personalities.
structure: Hook: 'Meet the person who ...'.
Name, role, how long they've been with you.
A fun fact or a quick question.
Them at work.
CTA: 'Say hi in the comments!'
hooks: Meet the people behind {subject}
The team that handles {subject}
howTo: Ask everyone the same fun question to make it a series.
Let them be themselves. Don't over-script.
Get their consent before posting.
items.example: A clinic introduces its receptionist, who remembers every patient's name.

ms.description: Perkenalkan orang di sebalik bisnes anda: peranan, personaliti dan fakta menarik tentang mereka.
ms.brief: Perkenalkan orang di sebalik {brand}, peranan dan personaliti mereka.
structure: Hook: "Kenali orang yang ...".
Nama, peranan, berapa lama bersama anda.
Fakta menarik atau soalan pantas.
Mereka sedang bekerja.
CTA: "Say hi di ruangan komen!"
hooks: Kenali orang di sebalik {subject}
Team yang uruskan {subject}
howTo: Tanya semua orang soalan seronok yang sama supaya ia jadi siri.
Biar mereka jadi diri sendiri. Jangan terlalu berskrip.
Dapatkan persetujuan mereka sebelum post.
ms.example: Klinik perkenalkan penyambut tetamu yang ingat nama setiap pesakit.

ms.question: Bagaimana anda akan sampaikan?
ms.description: Format video. Pilihan di sini bergantung pada jenis content yang anda pilih.

categories.label: Shooting Style
categories.question: How will you shoot it?
categories.description: How the camera captures the content: the technique, the setting or the movement.

items.label: Whip Pan
items.description: A very fast swing of the camera left or right that blurs the frame, used as a transition between scenes. It adds energy and makes cuts feel seamless.
items.brief: Use fast whip pans to jump between scenes or points. It keeps the energy high.
howTo: Swing the phone quickly in one direction at the end of shot A.
Start shot B with a swing in the same direction, then stop on your subject.
Cut the two clips in the middle of the blur so it looks like one move.
Keep the swing speed and direction consistent across the video.
items.example: Each point of a Top 3 list is revealed with a whip pan to a new spot in the shop.

ms.description: Hayunan kamera yang sangat laju ke kiri atau kanan sehingga gambar kabur, digunakan sebagai transisi antara babak. Ia menambah tenaga dan buat potongan nampak lancar.
ms.brief: Guna whip pan yang laju untuk lompat antara babak atau poin. Ia kekalkan tenaga video.
howTo: Hayun telefon dengan laju ke satu arah di hujung shot A.
Mulakan shot B dengan hayunan ke arah yang sama, kemudian berhenti pada subjek.
Potong kedua-dua klip di tengah kekaburan supaya nampak macam satu gerakan.
Kekalkan kelajuan dan arah hayunan yang sama sepanjang video.
ms.example: Setiap poin dalam senarai Top 3 didedahkan dengan whip pan ke sudut lain di kedai.

items.label: Reaction
items.description: Film genuine reactions (yours or someone else's) to a product, a taste, a reveal or another video. Faces make people stop scrolling.
items.brief: Capture real reactions on camera. Faces and first impressions sell the moment.
howTo: Film the reaction in close-up with the face well lit.
Don't over-script it; genuine surprise wins.
Use picture-in-picture or split screen when reacting to another video.
Keep the reaction short and cut to the best moment.
items.example: Customers taste the new menu item for the first time on camera.

ms.description: Rakam reaksi sebenar (anda atau orang lain) terhadap produk, rasa, pendedahan atau video lain. Muka manusia buat orang berhenti scroll.
ms.brief: Rakam reaksi sebenar di depan kamera. Muka dan tanggapan pertama yang menjual.
howTo: Rakam reaksi secara close-up dengan muka yang cukup cahaya.
Jangan terlalu berskrip; terkejut yang ikhlas paling berkesan.
Guna picture-in-picture atau split screen bila bereaksi kepada video lain.
Pendekkan reaksi dan potong ke saat terbaik.
ms.example: Pelanggan rasa menu baharu buat kali pertama di depan kamera.

items.label: Outdoor
items.description: Shoot outside: on location, in the street, at the site. Natural light and real surroundings make content feel authentic.
items.brief: Shoot it outdoors on location for natural light and real-world context.
howTo: Film in the morning or late afternoon for soft light; avoid harsh noon sun.
Use a clip-on mic. Wind and traffic ruin audio.
Pick a background that tells viewers where you are.
Check who and what is in frame; get permission when needed.
items.example: A property agent films a talk in front of the new development.

ms.description: Rakam di luar: di lokasi, di jalan, di tapak. Cahaya semula jadi dan suasana sebenar buat content terasa asli.
ms.brief: Rakam di luar, di lokasi sebenar, untuk cahaya semula jadi dan suasana dunia nyata.
howTo: Rakam waktu pagi atau lewat petang untuk cahaya lembut; elak matahari terik tengah hari.
Guna mikrofon klip. Angin dan trafik merosakkan audio.
Pilih latar belakang yang beritahu penonton di mana anda berada.
Semak siapa dan apa yang masuk dalam frame; minta izin bila perlu.
ms.example: Ejen hartanah bercakap di depan projek perumahan baharu.

items.label: Indoor
items.description: Shoot inside a space you control: your shop, office, studio or home. You control the light, sound and background.
items.brief: Shoot indoors in a controlled space so the light, sound and background stay clean.
howTo: Face a window, or put a ring light or softbox in front of you.
Tidy the background and add one element that shows your brand.
Turn off fans and air-cond during takes for clean audio.
Keep the camera at eye level.
items.example: A consultant films a talking-head tip at a desk with the logo on the wall behind.

ms.description: Rakam di dalam ruang yang anda kawal: kedai, pejabat, studio atau rumah. Anda kawal cahaya, bunyi dan latar belakang.
ms.brief: Rakam di dalam ruang terkawal supaya cahaya, bunyi dan latar belakang kekal kemas.
howTo: Hadap tingkap, atau letak ring light atau softbox di depan anda.
Kemaskan latar belakang dan tambah satu elemen yang tunjuk jenama anda.
Tutup kipas dan aircond semasa rakaman untuk audio yang bersih.
Letak kamera paras mata.
ms.example: Perunding rakam tip talking head di meja dengan logo di dinding belakang.

items.label: Moving
items.description: The camera or presenter is in motion: walking and talking, following the subject, or filming from a moving car. Motion keeps the eye engaged.
items.brief: Keep the camera moving (walk and talk, or follow the action) so every frame feels alive.
howTo: Hold the phone with both hands close to your body, or use a gimbal.
Walk heel-to-toe to reduce shake.
Plan your route so you don't stop mid-sentence.
Turn on stabilisation in your camera settings.
items.example: An owner walks through the shop explaining each section while the camera follows.

ms.description: Kamera atau penyampai sedang bergerak: berjalan sambil bercakap, mengikut subjek, atau merakam dari kereta. Pergerakan kekalkan perhatian mata.
ms.brief: Kekalkan kamera bergerak (jalan sambil bercakap, atau ikut aksi) supaya setiap frame terasa hidup.
howTo: Pegang telefon dengan dua tangan rapat ke badan, atau guna gimbal.
Berjalan tumit-ke-jari untuk kurangkan goyangan.
Rancang laluan supaya anda tak berhenti di tengah ayat.
Hidupkan stabilisation dalam tetapan kamera.
ms.example: Pemilik berjalan di dalam kedai menerangkan setiap bahagian sambil kamera mengikut.

items.label: Highlight
items.description: A fast montage of the best moments (an event, a day, a project) cut to music. It shows a lot in a few seconds.
items.brief: Cut the best moments into a fast highlight reel synced to music.
howTo: Film lots of short 2–3 second clips from different angles.
Cut on the beat of the music.
Open with your strongest clip.
Keep the whole thing under 30 seconds.
items.example: An event company's 20-second recap of a wedding, cut to a trending song.

ms.description: Montaj pantas saat-saat terbaik (majlis, sehari, projek) dipotong mengikut muzik. Banyak yang ditunjuk dalam beberapa saat.
ms.brief: Potong saat-saat terbaik menjadi highlight reel yang pantas, selari dengan muzik.
howTo: Rakam banyak klip pendek 2–3 saat dari sudut berbeza.
Potong mengikut rentak muzik.
Buka dengan klip paling kuat.
Keseluruhan video bawah 30 saat.
ms.example: Recap 20 saat syarikat event untuk majlis perkahwinan, dipotong mengikut lagu trending.

items.label: Foodie
items.description: The food-review style: close-ups of the food, the first bite, an honest reaction and quick details on price and location.
items.brief: Shoot it foodie-review style: close-ups, the first bite, an honest reaction and the key details.
howTo: Get tight close-ups: the pull, the pour, the steam, the crunch.
Film the first bite and react honestly.
Put the price, location and opening hours on screen.
Shoot near natural light for appetising colours.

references.label: KL Foodie
references.note: Study how they open the video, frame the food and deliver the verdict.

references.label: Bang Sadok
references.note: Study how they open the video, frame the food and deliver the verdict.

items.example: A restaurant owner reviews their own signature dish like a food critic.

ms.description: Gaya review makanan: close-up makanan, suapan pertama, reaksi jujur dan info ringkas tentang harga dan lokasi.
ms.brief: Rakam gaya review makanan: close-up, suapan pertama, reaksi jujur dan info penting.
howTo: Ambil close-up yang rapat: tarikan, tuangan, wap, bunyi rangup.
Rakam suapan pertama dan beri reaksi jujur.
Letak harga, lokasi dan waktu operasi di skrin.
Rakam dekat cahaya semula jadi supaya warna makanan nampak menyelerakan.
ms.example: Pemilik restoran review hidangan istimewa sendiri macam pengkritik makanan.

items.label: Talking Head
items.description: You speak directly to the camera, framed from the chest up. Simple, personal and the fastest way to build trust.
items.brief: Talk straight to camera, framed chest-up, like you're chatting to one friend.
howTo: Put the lens at eye level and look into it, not at the screen.
Cut out pauses with jump cuts to keep the pace up.
Add captions. Most people watch on mute.
Change the angle or zoom every few seconds to reset attention.
items.example: A lawyer answers one common question about wills in 45 seconds.

ms.description: Anda bercakap terus ke kamera, frame dari paras dada ke atas. Mudah, peribadi dan cara paling cepat membina kepercayaan.
ms.brief: Bercakap terus ke kamera, frame paras dada, macam berbual dengan seorang kawan.
howTo: Letak lensa paras mata dan pandang lensa, bukan skrin.
Buang jeda dengan jump cut untuk kekalkan rentak.
Tambah kapsyen. Ramai orang tonton tanpa bunyi.
Tukar sudut atau zoom setiap beberapa saat untuk segarkan perhatian.
ms.example: Peguam jawab satu soalan biasa tentang wasiat dalam 45 saat.

items.label: POV
items.description: Shot from the viewer's point of view, as if they are the one doing it. Very immersive and great for 'what it's like' content.
items.brief: Shoot from a first-person point of view so viewers feel like they're doing it.
howTo: Hold the phone at eye or chest level, pointing where your eyes look.
Show your hands in frame to make it feel real.
Add a 'POV:' caption to set the scene.
Move slowly. POV shots get shaky fast.
items.example: POV: you're the barista during the lunch rush.

ms.description: Dirakam dari sudut pandang penonton, seolah-olah mereka yang sedang melakukannya. Sangat mengasyikkan dan sesuai untuk content "macam mana rasanya".
ms.brief: Rakam dari sudut pandang orang pertama supaya penonton rasa mereka yang sedang buat.
howTo: Pegang telefon paras mata atau dada, menghala ke arah mata anda memandang.
Tunjuk tangan dalam frame supaya terasa nyata.
Tambah kapsyen "POV:" untuk sediakan babak.
Bergerak perlahan. Shot POV cepat goyang.
ms.example: POV: anda barista masa waktu puncak makan tengah hari.

items.label: Green Screen
items.description: You appear in front of an image, article, website or video. Perfect for reacting to news, reviews or screenshots.
items.brief: Use the green-screen effect to talk in front of a screenshot, article or image.
howTo: Use the app's built-in green screen effect. No real green screen needed.
Pick a clear, readable background image.
Point to what you're talking about on screen.
Swap the background for each point.
items.example: An accountant reacts to a news headline about new tax rules.

ms.description: Anda muncul di depan gambar, artikel, laman web atau video. Sesuai untuk bereaksi kepada berita, review atau screenshot.
ms.brief: Guna kesan green screen untuk bercakap di depan screenshot, artikel atau gambar.
howTo: Guna kesan green screen dalam app. Tak perlu green screen sebenar.
Pilih gambar latar yang jelas dan mudah dibaca.
Tunjuk ke arah apa yang anda bincangkan di skrin.
Tukar latar belakang untuk setiap poin.
ms.example: Akauntan bereaksi kepada tajuk berita tentang peraturan cukai baharu.

items.label: Street Interview
items.description: Ask members of the public a question and film their answers. Real people, real opinions, very shareable.
items.brief: Ask real people a question on the street and film their honest answers.
howTo: Use a handheld or clip-on wireless mic.
Ask a short, fun question that's easy to answer.
Always ask permission before filming and posting.
Keep only the best 3–5 answers.
items.example: A fitness brand asks people in a mall: how many push-ups can you do?

ms.description: Tanya orang ramai satu soalan dan rakam jawapan mereka. Orang sebenar, pendapat sebenar, sangat mudah dikongsi.
ms.brief: Tanya orang ramai satu soalan di jalan dan rakam jawapan jujur mereka.
howTo: Guna mikrofon wayarles pegang tangan atau klip.
Tanya soalan pendek dan seronok yang mudah dijawab.
Sentiasa minta izin sebelum rakam dan post.
Simpan 3–5 jawapan terbaik sahaja.
ms.example: Jenama kecergasan tanya orang di mall: berapa push-up anda boleh buat?

items.label: Voiceover + B-roll
items.description: Record your voice separately and lay it over supporting footage (B-roll). Great if you're shy on camera.
items.brief: Record a voiceover and cover it with B-roll footage. No need to show your face.
howTo: Write and record the voiceover first, then film footage to match.
Record in a quiet room with the phone close to your mouth.
Change shots every 2–3 seconds.
Build a B-roll library of your shop, product and team to reuse.
items.example: A candle brand narrates its story over clips of pouring and packing.

ms.description: Rakam suara anda berasingan dan letak di atas footage sokongan (B-roll). Sesuai kalau anda malu di depan kamera.
ms.brief: Rakam voiceover dan tutup dengan footage B-roll. Tak perlu tunjuk muka.
howTo: Tulis dan rakam voiceover dahulu, kemudian rakam footage yang sepadan.
Rakam dalam bilik senyap dengan telefon dekat dengan mulut.
Tukar shot setiap 2–3 saat.
Bina koleksi B-roll kedai, produk dan team untuk digunakan semula.
ms.example: Jenama lilin bercerita tentang jenamanya di atas klip menuang dan membungkus.

items.label: Close-up / ASMR
items.description: Extreme close-ups with satisfying sounds: pouring, cutting, packing, unboxing. Oddly satisfying content gets watched to the end and replayed.
items.brief: Go extreme close-up and let the satisfying sounds do the talking.
howTo: Get the phone as close as it can focus.
Record in a silent room; sound is half the content.
Use slow, deliberate movements.
Skip the music, or keep it very low.
items.example: An online shop films orders being packed, with every crinkle and tape sound.

ms.description: Close-up yang sangat dekat dengan bunyi yang memuaskan: menuang, memotong, membungkus, unboxing. Content yang "satisfying" ditonton sampai habis dan diulang.
ms.brief: Rakam close-up yang sangat dekat dan biar bunyi yang memuaskan bercakap.
howTo: Dekatkan telefon sedekat yang ia boleh fokus.
Rakam dalam bilik senyap; bunyi ialah separuh daripada content.
Guna pergerakan yang perlahan dan teratur.
Tak perlu muzik, atau kecilkan sangat.
ms.example: Kedai online rakam order dibungkus, dengan setiap bunyi plastik dan pita pelekat.

items.label: Split Screen / Duet
items.description: Two videos side by side: before/after, A vs B, or you reacting to another creator's video with Duet or Remix.
items.brief: Use a split screen to compare two things, or duet another video.
howTo: Use the Duet, Remix or Collab features on TikTok, Reels or Shorts.
Line up both sides so the action happens at the same time.
Label each side clearly.
Works great with the Reaction and A or B styles.
items.example: A tailor duets a viral 'fashion fail' video, showing how to fix it.

ms.description: Dua video bersebelahan: sebelum/selepas, A vs B, atau anda bereaksi kepada video creator lain dengan Duet atau Remix.
ms.brief: Guna split screen untuk bandingkan dua perkara, atau duet video lain.
howTo: Guna ciri Duet, Remix atau Collab di TikTok, Reels atau Shorts.
Selaraskan kedua-dua belah supaya aksi berlaku serentak.
Labelkan setiap belah dengan jelas.
Sangat sesuai dengan gaya Reaction dan A or B.
ms.example: Tukang jahit duet video "fashion fail" yang viral dan tunjuk cara membaikinya.

ms.question: Bagaimana anda akan rakam?
ms.description: Cara kamera merakam content: teknik, lokasi atau pergerakan.

categories.label: Topic
categories.question: What will you talk about?
categories.description: The subject of the content: what it's about.

items.label: Product & Service
items.description: Talk about what you sell: features, benefits, how it's made and how to use it.
items.brief: Focus on {product}: what it is, why it's better, and how to use it.
howTo: Focus on one feature or benefit per video.
Show the product in use, not just sitting on a table.
Answer the viewer's question: what's in it for me?
items.example: Why our kuih is made fresh every morning, never frozen.
hooks: What makes {subject} different
Why our customers choose {subject}
Everything you get with {subject}

ms.description: Bercakap tentang apa yang anda jual: ciri, manfaat, cara ia dibuat dan cara menggunakannya.
ms.brief: Fokus pada {product}: apa ia, kenapa ia lebih baik, dan cara menggunakannya.
howTo: Fokus pada satu ciri atau manfaat untuk satu video.
Tunjuk produk sedang digunakan, bukan sekadar terletak di atas meja.
Jawab soalan penonton: apa untungnya untuk saya?
ms.example: Kenapa kuih kami dibuat segar setiap pagi, tak pernah dibekukan.
hooks: Apa yang buat {subject} berbeza
Kenapa pelanggan kami pilih {subject}
Semua yang anda dapat dengan {subject}

items.label: Target Market
items.description: Talk about your ideal customers (their problems, wants and daily lives) so they feel seen.
items.brief: Speak directly to {audience}: their problems, wants and daily life, so they feel seen.
howTo: Use their words. Read your comments and DMs for the phrases they use.
Call them out in the first line.
Show you understand the problem before offering a solution.
items.example: 3 things every first-time home buyer worries about.
hooks: {audience}, this one is about {subject}
What {audience} should know about {subject}
Made for {audience}: {subject}

ms.description: Bercakap tentang pelanggan ideal anda (masalah, kehendak dan kehidupan harian mereka) supaya mereka rasa difahami.
ms.brief: Bercakap terus kepada {audience}: masalah, kehendak dan kehidupan harian mereka, supaya mereka rasa difahami.
howTo: Guna perkataan mereka. Baca komen dan DM untuk frasa yang mereka guna.
Panggil mereka dalam ayat pertama.
Tunjuk anda faham masalahnya sebelum tawarkan penyelesaian.
ms.example: 3 perkara yang setiap pembeli rumah pertama risaukan.
hooks: {audience}, video ini tentang {subject}
Apa yang {audience} perlu tahu tentang {subject}
Khas untuk {audience}: {subject}

items.label: Leads Generation
items.description: Content designed to collect contacts or enquiries: people who comment, DM or sign up to get something from you.
items.brief: Give {audience} a reason to reach out: a freebie, quote or trial in exchange for a comment, DM or sign-up.
howTo: Offer something valuable and specific (price list, checklist, free consultation).
Use a keyword CTA: 'Comment NAK and we'll DM you.'
Follow up every lead within 24 hours.
Track how many leads each video brings in.
items.example: Comment 'RUMAH' and we'll send you our free first-home buyer checklist.
hooks: Comment 'NAK' and I'll send you everything about {subject}
Want the full guide to {subject}? Comment below
DM us for the details on {subject}

ms.description: Content untuk kumpul kenalan atau pertanyaan: orang yang komen, DM atau daftar untuk dapatkan sesuatu daripada anda.
ms.brief: Beri {audience} sebab untuk hubungi anda: barang percuma, sebut harga atau percubaan sebagai ganti komen, DM atau pendaftaran.
howTo: Tawarkan sesuatu yang bernilai dan spesifik (senarai harga, senarai semak, konsultasi percuma).
Guna CTA kata kunci: "Komen NAK dan kami DM anda."
Susuli setiap lead dalam 24 jam.
Jejak berapa lead yang setiap video bawa.
ms.example: Komen "RUMAH" dan kami hantar senarai semak percuma untuk pembeli rumah pertama.
hooks: Komen 'NAK' dan saya hantar semua info tentang {subject}
Nak panduan penuh tentang {subject}? Komen di bawah
DM kami untuk dapatkan info tentang {subject}

items.label: Demographic
items.description: Tailor content to one specific group (by age, gender, location, income or life stage) so it feels made for them.
items.brief: Make it for one specific group within {audience} (by age, life stage or location) so it feels personal.
howTo: Pick one group per video. 'Everyone' means no one.
Name the group in the hook.
Use examples and situations that group recognises.
items.example: Skincare in your 20s vs your 40s: what should change?
hooks: Gen Z vs millennials on {subject}
Students vs working adults: {subject}
New to this? Here's your guide to {subject}

ms.description: Sesuaikan content dengan satu kumpulan spesifik (umur, jantina, lokasi, pendapatan atau peringkat hidup) supaya ia terasa dibuat untuk mereka.
ms.brief: Buat untuk satu kumpulan spesifik dalam {audience} (umur, peringkat hidup atau lokasi) supaya ia terasa peribadi.
howTo: Satu kumpulan untuk satu video. "Semua orang" bermaksud tiada siapa.
Sebut kumpulan itu dalam hook.
Guna contoh dan situasi yang kumpulan itu kenal.
ms.example: Skincare umur 20-an vs 40-an: apa yang patut berubah?
hooks: Gen Z vs milenial tentang {subject}
Pelajar vs orang bekerja: {subject}
Baru nak cuba? Ini panduan anda untuk {subject}

items.label: Current Issues
items.description: Connect your business to what people are talking about right now: news, viral moments, policy changes, price hikes.
items.brief: Link {brand} to what people are talking about right now so the content feels timely.
howTo: Move fast. Current issues expire in days.
Add your expert view; don't just repeat the news.
Stay away from sensitive topics (race, religion, royalty) unless you're sure it's appropriate.
items.example: What the new electricity tariff means for small restaurant owners.
hooks: Everyone's talking about this, so let's talk about {subject}
What this week's news means for {subject}
Prices are going up. Here's what it means for {subject}

ms.description: Kaitkan bisnes anda dengan apa yang orang sedang bualkan: berita, saat viral, perubahan polisi, kenaikan harga.
ms.brief: Kaitkan {brand} dengan apa yang orang sedang bualkan supaya content terasa semasa.
howTo: Bergerak cepat. Isu semasa luput dalam beberapa hari.
Tambah pandangan pakar anda; jangan sekadar ulang berita.
Jauhi topik sensitif (3R: kaum, agama, raja) kecuali anda pasti ia sesuai.
ms.example: Apa maksud tarif elektrik baharu untuk pemilik restoran kecil.
hooks: Semua orang tengah bercakap tentang ini, jadi jom cakap tentang {subject}
Apa maksud berita minggu ini untuk {subject}
Harga barang naik. Ini kesannya pada {subject}

items.label: General Knowledge
items.description: Interesting facts, history and trivia about your industry that people enjoy learning and passing on.
items.brief: Share interesting knowledge about {niche} that people enjoy learning and passing on.
howTo: Pick facts that make people say 'wow' or 'I never knew that'.
Tie the fact back to your business in one line.
Double-check your sources.
items.example: The real reason nasi lemak is wrapped in banana leaf.
hooks: A fun fact about {subject}
The history behind {subject} in 30 seconds
Did you know this about {subject}?

ms.description: Fakta menarik, sejarah dan trivia tentang industri anda yang orang suka belajar dan kongsi.
ms.brief: Kongsi pengetahuan menarik tentang {niche} yang orang suka belajar dan kongsi.
howTo: Pilih fakta yang buat orang kata "wow" atau "tak tahu pun".
Kaitkan fakta dengan bisnes anda dalam satu ayat.
Semak semula sumber anda.
ms.example: Sebab sebenar nasi lemak dibungkus dengan daun pisang.
hooks: Fakta menarik tentang {subject}
Sejarah di sebalik {subject} dalam 30 saat
Tahukah anda ini tentang {subject}?

items.label: FAQ
items.description: Answer the questions customers ask you again and again: in DMs, on WhatsApp, at the counter.
items.brief: Answer one question {audience} ask you again and again.
howTo: Keep a running list of questions from DMs and WhatsApp. Each one is a video.
One question per video.
Reply to a comment with a video answer.
items.example: Do you deliver to Sabah and Sarawak? Here's how it works.
hooks: You asked, we answered: {subject}
The question we get every day about {subject}
Answering your top questions about {subject}

ms.description: Jawab soalan yang pelanggan tanya berulang kali: dalam DM, di WhatsApp, di kaunter.
ms.brief: Jawab satu soalan yang {audience} tanya berulang kali.
howTo: Simpan senarai soalan daripada DM dan WhatsApp. Setiap satu ialah video.
Satu soalan untuk satu video.
Balas komen dengan jawapan dalam bentuk video.
ms.example: Ada hantar ke Sabah dan Sarawak? Ini caranya.
hooks: Anda tanya, kami jawab: {subject}
Soalan yang kami dapat setiap hari tentang {subject}
Jawapan kepada soalan popular tentang {subject}

items.label: Behind the Brand
items.description: Your founder story, values, team and mission: the people and the 'why' behind the business.
items.brief: Show the people and the 'why' behind {brand}.
howTo: Be personal and honest. That's what makes it connect.
Share the values that affect how you serve customers.
Turn it into a series (Episode 1, 2, 3...).
items.example: Why we still hand-pack every order even though we could automate it.
hooks: Why we care so much about {subject}
The story you haven't heard about {subject}
What {brand} believes about {subject}

ms.description: Kisah pengasas, nilai, team dan misi anda: orang dan "kenapa" di sebalik bisnes ini.
ms.brief: Tunjuk orang dan "kenapa" di sebalik {brand}.
howTo: Jadi peribadi dan jujur. Itu yang buat orang rasa dekat.
Kongsi nilai yang mempengaruhi cara anda layan pelanggan.
Jadikan siri (Episod 1, 2, 3...).
ms.example: Kenapa kami masih bungkus setiap order dengan tangan walaupun boleh guna mesin.
hooks: Kenapa kami sangat ambil berat tentang {subject}
Cerita yang anda belum dengar tentang {subject}
Apa yang {brand} percaya tentang {subject}

items.label: Festive & Seasonal
items.description: Tie your content to the calendar: Raya, CNY, Deepavali, Christmas, Merdeka, school holidays, payday, year-end sales.
items.brief: Tie it to the season (festive, holidays or payday) so it's relevant this week.
howTo: Plan festive content 3–4 weeks ahead.
Respect the culture and traditions of each festival.
Pair it with a festive offer or limited edition.
items.example: 5 Raya open house menu ideas you can order from us.
hooks: Getting ready for the festive season with {subject}
Raya is coming. Have you sorted out {subject}?
Holiday plans? Don't forget {subject}

ms.description: Kaitkan content dengan kalendar: Raya, Tahun Baru Cina, Deepavali, Krismas, Merdeka, cuti sekolah, hari gaji, jualan akhir tahun.
ms.brief: Kaitkan dengan musim (perayaan, cuti atau hari gaji) supaya ia relevan minggu ini.
howTo: Rancang content perayaan 3–4 minggu lebih awal.
Hormati budaya dan tradisi setiap perayaan.
Gandingkan dengan tawaran perayaan atau edisi terhad.
ms.example: 5 idea menu rumah terbuka Raya yang anda boleh tempah daripada kami.
hooks: Bersiap untuk musim perayaan dengan {subject}
Raya dah dekat. Dah settle {subject}?
Ada plan cuti? Jangan lupa {subject}

items.label: Tips & Hacks
items.description: Quick, practical tips that save time, money or effort. Instantly useful and very saveable.
items.brief: Give a quick, practical tip that saves {audience} time, money or effort.
howTo: One tip per video, shown in action.
Put the result at the start.
Ask them to save it.
items.example: The trick to keeping your kek lapis moist for two weeks.
hooks: The hack nobody told you about {subject}
Try this trick with {subject}
Save this tip for {subject}

ms.description: Tips praktikal yang pantas untuk jimat masa, duit atau tenaga. Terus berguna dan orang suka save.
ms.brief: Beri satu tip praktikal yang jimatkan masa, duit atau tenaga {audience}.
howTo: Satu tip untuk satu video, ditunjuk secara langsung.
Letak hasilnya di awal.
Minta mereka save video.
ms.example: Rahsia kekalkan kek lapis lembap selama dua minggu.
hooks: Hack yang tiada siapa beritahu tentang {subject}
Cuba trick ini dengan {subject}
Save tip ini untuk {subject}

ms.question: Apa yang anda akan bincangkan?
ms.description: Subjek content: video ini tentang apa.

categories.label: Hook
categories.question: How will you grab attention in the first 3 seconds?
categories.description: The first 3 seconds decide whether people keep watching. Pick an opening technique.

items.label: Question
items.description: Open with a question the viewer wants answered, so they stay for the answer.
items.brief: Open with a question viewers need answered.
hooks: Have you ever wondered about {subject}?
Why does nobody talk about {subject}?
howTo: Ask something your audience has actually wondered.
Put the question on screen as text too.
Answer it by the end. Don't bait and switch.

ms.description: Buka dengan soalan yang penonton nak tahu jawapannya, supaya mereka terus tonton.
ms.brief: Buka dengan soalan yang penonton perlu tahu jawapannya.
hooks: Pernah tak anda terfikir tentang {subject}?
Kenapa tiada siapa bercakap tentang {subject}?
howTo: Tanya sesuatu yang audiens anda memang pernah tertanya-tanya.
Letak soalan sebagai teks di skrin juga.
Jawab sebelum video habis. Jangan umpan kosong.

items.label: Bold Statement
items.description: Open with a strong, slightly controversial claim that makes people want to argue or learn more.
items.brief: Open with a bold, slightly controversial statement.
hooks: Everything you know about {subject} is wrong.
This will change how you think about {subject}.
howTo: Say it with confidence, straight to camera.
Back it up in the video, or you lose trust.
Controversial is fine; offensive is not.

ms.description: Buka dengan kenyataan yang kuat dan sedikit kontroversi supaya orang nak berdebat atau tahu lebih lanjut.
ms.brief: Buka dengan kenyataan berani yang sedikit kontroversi.
hooks: Semua yang anda tahu tentang {subject} adalah salah.
Ini akan ubah cara anda fikir tentang {subject}.
howTo: Cakap dengan yakin, terus ke kamera.
Buktikan dalam video, atau anda hilang kepercayaan.
Kontroversi tak apa; menyinggung tidak.

items.label: POV Setup
items.description: Set a scene with a 'POV:' caption so viewers instantly imagine themselves in it.
items.brief: Open with a 'POV:' caption that puts viewers in the scene.
hooks: POV: you just found out the truth about {subject}
POV: your friend won't stop talking about {subject}
howTo: The POV line must be readable in under 2 seconds.
Make it relatable to your target audience.
Pairs well with the POV shooting style and Lakonan.

ms.description: Sediakan babak dengan kapsyen "POV:" supaya penonton terus bayangkan diri mereka di situ.
ms.brief: Buka dengan kapsyen "POV:" yang letak penonton dalam babak.
hooks: POV: anda baru tahu kebenaran tentang {subject}
POV: kawan anda tak berhenti cakap tentang {subject}
howTo: Ayat POV mesti boleh dibaca bawah 2 saat.
Buat ia relate dengan audiens sasaran.
Sesuai dengan gaya rakaman POV dan Lakonan.

items.label: Call-out
items.description: Call out a specific group so they feel the video was made just for them.
items.brief: Open by calling out {audience} directly.
hooks: Calling all {audience}: let's talk about {subject}.
{audience}, this one's for you. It's about {subject}.
howTo: Be specific: 'first-time home buyers', not 'everyone'.
Say it and show it as text in the first second.

ms.description: Panggil satu kumpulan spesifik supaya mereka rasa video ini dibuat khas untuk mereka.
ms.brief: Buka dengan memanggil {audience} secara terus.
hooks: Untuk semua {audience}: jom cakap tentang {subject}.
{audience}, video ini untuk anda. Ia tentang {subject}.
howTo: Spesifik: "pembeli rumah pertama", bukan "semua orang".
Sebut dan tunjuk sebagai teks dalam saat pertama.

items.label: Shocking Number
items.description: Open with a surprising statistic or number.
items.brief: Open with a surprising number or statistic.
hooks: 9 out of 10 people don't know this about {subject}.
Only 1% of people know this about {subject}.
howTo: Use real numbers. Make sure the statistic is true.
Show the number big on screen.

ms.description: Buka dengan statistik atau angka yang mengejutkan.
ms.brief: Buka dengan angka atau statistik yang mengejutkan.
hooks: 9 daripada 10 orang tak tahu ini tentang {subject}.
Hanya 1% orang tahu ini tentang {subject}.
howTo: Guna angka sebenar. Pastikan statistik itu benar.
Tunjuk angka besar di skrin.

items.label: Mistake Warning
items.description: Warn viewers about a mistake they might be making. Nobody wants to be the one getting it wrong.
items.brief: Open with a warning about a common mistake.
hooks: Stop making this mistake when it comes to {subject}.
The #1 mistake people make when it comes to {subject}.
howTo: Name the mistake fast, then explain the fix.
Use a red cross or buzzer sound for emphasis.

ms.description: Beri amaran tentang kesilapan yang mungkin penonton sedang buat. Tiada siapa nak jadi orang yang buat silap.
ms.brief: Buka dengan amaran tentang kesilapan biasa.
hooks: Berhenti buat kesilapan ini bila melibatkan {subject}.
Kesilapan #1 yang orang buat bila melibatkan {subject}.
howTo: Sebut kesilapan dengan cepat, kemudian terangkan cara betulkan.
Guna pangkah merah atau bunyi buzzer untuk penekanan.

items.label: Result First
items.description: Show the final result in the first second, then explain how you got there.
items.brief: Open with the end result, then show how you got there.
hooks: Here's the end result. Now let me show you {subject}.
Watch till the end to see what happened with {subject}.
howTo: The result must be visually impressive.
Works great with Before & After and How-To.

ms.description: Tunjuk hasil akhir dalam saat pertama, kemudian terangkan bagaimana anda sampai ke situ.
ms.brief: Buka dengan hasil akhir, kemudian tunjuk cara anda sampai ke situ.
hooks: Ini hasil akhirnya. Sekarang saya tunjukkan {subject}.
Tonton sampai habis untuk tengok apa jadi dengan {subject}.
howTo: Hasil mesti nampak hebat secara visual.
Sangat sesuai dengan Before & After dan How-To.

items.label: Challenge
items.description: Challenge viewers to guess, spot or answer something before you reveal it.
items.brief: Open by challenging viewers to guess before the reveal.
hooks: I bet you can't guess this about {subject}.
Try not to be surprised by this about {subject}.
howTo: Make the reveal worth waiting for.
Tell them to comment their guess before the reveal.

ms.description: Cabar penonton untuk teka, cari atau jawab sesuatu sebelum anda dedahkan.
ms.brief: Buka dengan mencabar penonton meneka sebelum didedahkan.
hooks: Saya berani kata anda tak dapat teka ini tentang {subject}.
Cuba jangan terkejut dengan fakta ini tentang {subject}.
howTo: Pastikan pendedahan berbaloi ditunggu.
Suruh mereka komen tekaan sebelum jawapan didedahkan.

ms.question: Bagaimana nak tarik perhatian dalam 3 saat pertama?
ms.description: 3 saat pertama menentukan sama ada orang terus menonton. Pilih teknik pembukaan.

categories.label: On Camera
categories.question: Who's on camera?
categories.description: The face (or hands, or voice) of the content.

items.label: Owner / Founder
items.description: The face of the business. People buy from people, and founders build the most trust.
items.brief: Put the owner or founder of {brand} on camera. People buy from people.
howTo: Be consistent. Show up regularly so people recognise you.
Share opinions and personality, not just information.

ms.description: Wajah bisnes. Orang beli daripada orang, dan pengasas membina kepercayaan paling tinggi.
ms.brief: Letak pemilik atau pengasas {brand} di depan kamera. Orang beli daripada orang.
howTo: Konsisten. Muncul selalu supaya orang kenal anda.
Kongsi pendapat dan personaliti, bukan maklumat sahaja.

items.label: Staff / Team
items.description: Your team members on camera. It shows your culture and shares the load of being the face of the brand.
items.brief: Feature your staff or team. It shows the culture behind {brand}.
howTo: Find the team members who enjoy being on camera.
Get written consent to feature staff.

ms.description: Ahli team anda di depan kamera. Ia tunjuk budaya kerja dan kongsi beban menjadi wajah jenama.
ms.brief: Tampilkan staf atau team anda. Ia tunjuk budaya di sebalik {brand}.
howTo: Cari ahli team yang seronok di depan kamera.
Dapatkan persetujuan bertulis untuk tampilkan staf.

items.label: Customer
items.description: Real customers on camera: reviews, reactions, before/after. The most believable proof there is.
items.brief: Put a real customer on camera. Nothing is more believable.
howTo: Ask right after a great experience, when they're happiest.
Always get permission to post.
A small thank-you gift makes people more willing.

ms.description: Pelanggan sebenar di depan kamera: review, reaksi, sebelum/selepas. Bukti yang paling dipercayai.
ms.brief: Letak pelanggan sebenar di depan kamera. Tiada yang lebih dipercayai.
howTo: Tanya sejurus selepas pengalaman yang hebat, ketika mereka paling gembira.
Sentiasa minta izin untuk post.
Hadiah terima kasih yang kecil buat orang lebih sudi.

items.label: Influencer / KOL
items.description: A creator or key opinion leader with their own audience features your brand.
items.brief: Bring in an influencer or KOL to borrow their audience and credibility.
howTo: Pick creators whose audience matches yours, not just the biggest follower count.
Give them a brief, but let them do it in their own style.
Agree on usage rights so you can repost.
