ms.description: Creator atau KOL dengan audiens sendiri yang menampilkan jenama anda.
ms.brief: Bawa masuk influencer atau KOL untuk pinjam audiens dan kredibiliti mereka.
howTo: Pilih creator yang audiensnya sepadan dengan anda, bukan sekadar follower paling ramai.
Beri brief, tetapi biar mereka buat dengan gaya sendiri.
Setuju tentang hak penggunaan supaya anda boleh repost.

items.label: Faceless
items.description: No face needed: hands, the product, a voiceover or text only. Great for camera-shy owners.
items.brief: Keep it faceless: hands, product, voiceover or text only.
howTo: Pairs well with Voiceover + B-roll, POV and Close-up.
Use a consistent voice or text style so people recognise you.

ms.description: Tak perlu muka: tangan, produk, voiceover atau teks sahaja. Sesuai untuk pemilik yang malu kamera.
ms.brief: Tanpa muka: tangan, produk, voiceover atau teks sahaja.
howTo: Sesuai dengan Voiceover + B-roll, POV dan Close-up.
Guna suara atau gaya teks yang konsisten supaya orang kenal anda.

items.label: Character / Persona
items.description: A recurring character you or your team play (a mak cik, a grumpy boss, a clueless customer). Audiences come back for characters.
items.brief: Use a recurring character or persona that audiences recognise and come back for.
howTo: Give the character a signature look, line or prop.
Put them in a series of situations from your business.
Keep it light and never mock real customers.

ms.description: Watak berulang yang anda atau team lakonkan (mak cik, bos garang, pelanggan blur). Audiens kembali kerana watak.
ms.brief: Guna watak atau persona berulang yang audiens kenal dan tunggu.
howTo: Beri watak itu rupa, ayat atau prop yang tersendiri.
Letak watak dalam siri situasi daripada bisnes anda.
Kekalkan santai dan jangan sesekali perlekehkan pelanggan sebenar.

ms.question: Siapa di depan kamera?
ms.description: Wajah (atau tangan, atau suara) content ini.

items.label: Funny
items.description: Make them laugh. Humour gets shared more than anything else.
items.brief: Make it funny. Humour gets shared.

ms.description: Buat mereka ketawa. Humor paling banyak dikongsi.
ms.brief: Buat ia lawak. Humor dikongsi.

items.label: Emotional
items.description: Make them feel something: pride, nostalgia, empathy, happiness.
items.brief: Make it emotional so it's remembered and shared.

ms.description: Buat mereka rasa sesuatu: bangga, nostalgia, empati, gembira.
ms.brief: Buat ia emosional supaya diingati dan dikongsi.

items.label: Serious / Expert
items.description: Calm, confident and factual. Positions you as the authority.
items.brief: Keep it serious and expert. Speak with authority.

ms.description: Tenang, yakin dan berfakta. Menjadikan anda pihak berautoriti.
ms.brief: Serius dan pakar. Bercakap dengan autoriti.

items.label: Hype / Energetic
items.description: Fast, loud and exciting. Great for launches, promos and events.
items.brief: Make it high-energy: fast cuts, big voice, upbeat music.

ms.description: Pantas, kuat dan mengujakan. Sesuai untuk pelancaran, promosi dan event.
ms.brief: Penuh tenaga: potongan pantas, suara lantang, muzik rancak.

items.label: Calm / Aesthetic
items.description: Slow, beautiful and satisfying. Soft music and clean visuals.
items.brief: Keep it calm and aesthetic: slow shots, soft music, clean visuals.

ms.description: Perlahan, cantik dan memuaskan. Muzik lembut dan visual yang kemas.
ms.brief: Tenang dan estetik: shot perlahan, muzik lembut, visual kemas.

items.label: Relatable / Casual
items.description: Like talking to a friend. Everyday language and situations people recognise.
items.brief: Keep it casual and relatable, like talking to a friend.

ms.description: Macam berbual dengan kawan. Bahasa harian dan situasi yang orang kenal.
ms.brief: Santai dan relate, macam berbual dengan kawan.

ms.question: Apa mood-nya?
ms.description: Bagaimana content ini patut dirasai oleh penonton.

categories.label: Call to Action
categories.question: What should viewers do next?
categories.description: The one action you want viewers to take at the end.

items.label: Comment
items.description: Ask viewers to comment: one word, one emoji or their opinion. Comments boost reach.
items.brief: Ask viewers to comment: one word, one emoji or their opinion.

ms.description: Minta penonton komen: satu perkataan, satu emoji atau pendapat mereka. Komen menaikkan reach.
ms.brief: Minta penonton komen: satu perkataan, satu emoji atau pendapat mereka.

items.label: Tag / Share
items.description: Ask viewers to tag or send it to a friend. Shares are the strongest signal for reach.
items.brief: Ask viewers to tag or share it with a friend who needs to see it.

ms.description: Minta penonton tag atau hantar kepada kawan. Share ialah isyarat paling kuat untuk reach.
ms.brief: Minta penonton tag atau share kepada kawan yang perlu tengok.

items.label: Save
items.description: Ask viewers to save the video for later. Best for Educate and Tips content.
items.brief: Ask viewers to save it for later.

ms.description: Minta penonton save video untuk rujukan. Paling sesuai untuk content Educate dan Tips.
ms.brief: Minta penonton save video untuk rujukan.

items.label: Follow for Part 2
items.description: Tease a part 2 and ask viewers to follow so they don't miss it.
items.brief: Tease a part 2 and ask viewers to follow so they don't miss it.

ms.description: Bayangkan part 2 dan minta penonton follow supaya tak terlepas.
ms.brief: Bayangkan part 2 dan minta penonton follow supaya tak terlepas.

items.label: Comment / DM Keyword
items.description: Ask viewers to comment or DM a keyword to receive something: a price list, link or freebie. Great for leads.
items.brief: Ask viewers to comment or DM a keyword (e.g. 'NAK') to receive something.

ms.description: Minta penonton komen atau DM kata kunci untuk dapatkan sesuatu: senarai harga, link atau barang percuma. Bagus untuk lead.
ms.brief: Minta penonton komen atau DM kata kunci (contoh "NAK") untuk dapatkan sesuatu.

items.label: WhatsApp Us
items.description: Send viewers to WhatsApp to enquire or order.
items.brief: Send viewers to WhatsApp {brand} to enquire or order.

ms.description: Hantar penonton ke WhatsApp untuk bertanya atau membuat tempahan.
ms.brief: Hantar penonton ke WhatsApp {brand} untuk bertanya atau membuat tempahan.

items.label: Link in Bio
items.description: Send viewers to the link in your bio to buy, book or sign up.
items.brief: Send viewers to the link in bio to buy, book or sign up.

ms.description: Hantar penonton ke link di bio untuk membeli, menempah atau mendaftar.
ms.brief: Hantar penonton ke link di bio untuk membeli, menempah atau mendaftar.

items.label: Visit Us
items.description: Invite viewers to come to your shop or location.
items.brief: Invite viewers to visit {brand} in person.

ms.description: Jemput penonton datang ke kedai atau lokasi anda.
ms.brief: Jemput penonton datang ke {brand}.

ms.question: Apa yang penonton patut buat seterusnya?
ms.description: Satu tindakan yang anda mahu penonton buat di akhir video.

items.label: 7–15 sec (Loop)
items.description: Ultra short and built to loop. Best for trends, reactions and one-liners.
items.brief: Keep it 7–15 seconds, built to loop.

ms.label: 7–15 saat (Loop)
ms.description: Sangat pendek dan dibina untuk berulang. Paling sesuai untuk trend, reaksi dan one-liner.
ms.brief: 7–15 saat, dibina untuk berulang.

items.label: 15–30 sec
items.description: The sweet spot for most short-form content.
items.brief: Aim for 15–30 seconds.

ms.label: 15–30 saat
ms.description: Tempoh paling sesuai untuk kebanyakan content pendek.
ms.brief: Sasarkan 15–30 saat.

items.label: 30–60 sec
items.description: Room for a list, a quick tutorial or a short story.
items.brief: Aim for 30–60 seconds.

ms.label: 30–60 saat
ms.description: Cukup ruang untuk senarai, tutorial ringkas atau cerita pendek.
ms.brief: Sasarkan 30–60 saat.

items.label: 60–90 sec
items.description: For storytelling and deeper explanations. Needs a strong hook and tight editing.
items.brief: Aim for 60–90 seconds with tight editing.

ms.label: 60–90 saat
ms.description: Untuk storytelling dan penerangan lebih mendalam. Perlukan hook kuat dan suntingan ketat.
ms.brief: Sasarkan 60–90 saat dengan suntingan ketat.

items.label: 2–3 min
items.description: Longer videos for stories, reviews and tutorials with real depth.
items.brief: Go for 2–3 minutes and keep a hook every 20–30 seconds.

ms.label: 2–3 minit
ms.description: Video lebih panjang untuk cerita, review dan tutorial yang mendalam.
ms.brief: Pilih 2–3 minit dan letak hook baru setiap 20–30 saat.

ms.question: Berapa panjang video ini?
ms.description: Tempoh sasaran video.
